games.name: [UPDATE] Conquest: Napoleonic Wars [Pre-Alpha]
games.desc:
Conquest: Napoleonic Wars is a real time strategy (RTS) game based on the Napoleonic era, inspired by Napoleon Total War and a successor to Conquest by captainwoodlegs. 

Keybinds
R = Rotate units
Z = Show units range
H = toggle march at same speed
X = ping
C = halt selected units
Q = select all the units
E = deselect all selected units
Left control = see all the units goals positions without having them selected
Left control and click on an unit = select units without deselect.
T + click = move units into a line automatically
Shift + click = move all the selected units in formation rather than all to the same place
Shift + click a unit = selecting all the units of the same type
Shift + press a number = select all units of the same type

MOBILE 
Double tap and hold = dragging to select multiple units at once

Use /private in your own private server to open or close the servers settings UI
Use /unstuck if ur character cant move

games.name: [EARLY PAID ACCESS] Havoc
games.desc:
Sale is live. The game is 250 R$ and the sale ends in Oct 15.

Havoc immerses players in the aftermath of The Silence, a world where factions fight for survival and territory.

This is a hardcore extraction shooter built around real risk and consequence. It is loud, punishing, and unforgiving. Headphones are strongly recommended to hear threats early, as success depends entirely on your skill.

Havoc is currently available as paid access. Purchasing grants immediate access to the current build and all future updates.

>> The game runs on seasonal wipes. Gear, stash, and progress reset each season, but your profile and cosmetics are permanent.

Keybinds can be viewed in the Settings menu but cannot be changed at the moment.

>> The game is available on Console and PC. Controllers are not supported; mouse and keyboard are required.
